detail.title: 4+4MP Dual-Sight Polarlight Bullet WizMind Network Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite IPC-MFW7449Y-Z7-T44 4+4MP Dual-Sight Polarlight Bullet WizMind Network Camera Key Points • Dual-Lens, Dual-Channel Design, See Farther, Cover Wider • CH 1: 4 MP@30fps; CH 2: 4 MP@30fps • CH 1: 8-56mm Motorized Vari-focal Lens; CH 2: 8-32mm Motorized Vari-focal Lens • Dual Micro-PTZ, Remotely Adjust Lenses Angles • Illumination by Area, Control Lighting Zones Independently • Simultaneous Enabling of CH1 and CH2 AI Functions • Time-Division Exposure Ensures Clearly Captures of People, Vehicles, and Non-motor vehicles Moving at Different Speeds • Dual Light Fusion Provides Multiple Illumination Modes, Minimize Glare Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: Channel 1: 0.0004 lux@F1.2(Color,30IRE) 0.0001 lux@F1.2(B/W,30IRE) 0 lux (Illuminator on) Channel 2: 0.0005 lux@F1.6(Color,30IRE) 0.0002 lux@F1.6(B/W,30IRE) 0 lux (Illuminator on)
General.Illumination Distance: Channel 1: 150 m (492.13 ft) (IR); 80 m (262.47 ft) (warm light) Channel 2: 120 m (393.70 ft) (IR); 80 m (262.47 ft) (warm light)
General.Illuminator Number: Channel 1: 8 (illuminator with dual light fusion) Channel 2: 2 (illuminator with dual light fusion)
General.Close Focus Distance: Channel 1: 1 m–2 m (3.28 ft–6.56 ft) Channel 2: 3 m–5.5 m (9.84 ft–18.04 ft)
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Intrusion, tripwire, fast moving (the three functions support the classification and accurate detection of vehicle and human); loitering detection, people gathering, and parking detection
General.Face Detection: Face detection; track; snapshot; snapshot optimization; optimal face snapshot upload; face enhancement; face exposure; face attributes extraction including 6 attributes (gender, age, glasses, expressions, mask, and beard) and 8 expressions (angry, sad, disgusted, scared, surprised, calm, happy, confused); face snapshot set as face or one-inch photo; snapshot strategies (real-time snapshot, quality priority and optimization snapshot); face angle filter; optimization time setting.
General.Face Recognition: Face detection; track; snapshot; snapshot optimization; optimal face snapshot upload; face enhancement; face exposure; face attributes extraction including 6 attributes (gender, age, glasses, expressions, mask, and beard) and 8 expressions (angry, sad, disgusted, scared, surprised, calm, happy, confused); face snapshot set as face or one-inch photo; snapshot strategies (recognition priority and optimization snapshot); face angle filter; optimization time setting. Supports adding 5 group face databases; registering person one by one or in batches; setting face similarity; and supports face comparison with the face database containing up to 100,000 face pictures.
General.People Counting: Tripwire people counting and people counting in area, generating and exporting report (day/month/year); queue management, generating and exporting report (day/month); 4 rules can be set for tripwire, people counting in area and queue management
General.Crowd Distribution Map: Crowd distribution map; global people counting; people counting in area
General.Video Metadata: Motor vehicle, non-motor vehicle, face, human body detection; track; snapshot; snapshot optimization; optimal face snapshot upload. Motor vehicle attributes: license plate, vehicle type, vehicle color, vehicle logo and other attributes : seatbelt, smoking, calling. Non-motor vehicle attributes: type, color, number of people, top type and color, hat. Human body attributes: gender, top/bottom type and color, bag, hat and umbrella. Face attributes: gender, age, expressions, glasses, face mask and beard.
General.Smart Search: Work together with Smart NVR to perform refine intelligent search, event extraction and merging to event videos
General.Video Compression: H.265; H.264; H.264H; H.264B; MJPEG (Only supported by the sub stream)
General.Video Frame Rate: Channel 1: Main stream: 2688 × 1520@(1-25/30 fps) sub stream: 1920 × 1080@(1-25/30 fps) third stream: 1920 × 1080@(1-25/30 fps) Channel 2: Main stream: 2688 × 1520@(1-25/30 fps) sub stream: 1920 × 1080@(1-25/30 fps) third stream: 1920 × 1080@(1-25/30 fps) *The values above are the max. frame rates of each stream; for multiple streams, the values will be subjected to the total encoding capacity.
General.Video Bit Rate: Channel 1: H.264: 32 kbps–15872 kbps H.265: 12 kbps–9472 kbps Channel 2: H.264: 32 kbps–15872 kbps H.265: 12 kbps–9472 kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; natural; street lamp; outdoor; manual; regional custom
General.Alarm Event: No SD card; SD card full; SD card error; network disconnection; IP conflict; illegal access; motion detection; video tampering; tripwire; intrusion; fast moving; abandoned object; missing object; loitering detection; people gathering; parking detection; scene changing; audio detection; voltage detection; defocus detection; external alarm; face detection; face recognition; video metadata; crowd density
General.Network Protocol: IPv4; IPv6; HTTP; TCP; UDP; ARP; RTP; RTSP; RTCP; RTMP; SMTP; FTP; SFTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; QoS; UPnP; NTP; Multicast; ICMP; IGMP; NFS; SAMBA; PPPoE; SNMP; P2P
General.Cyber Security: Configuration encryption; trusted execution; Digest; security logs; WSSE; account lockout; syslog; video encryption; 802.1x; IP/MAC filtering; HTTPS; trusted upgrade; trusted boot; firmware encryption; generation and importing of X.509 certification
General.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile S/Profile G/ Profile T); CGI
General.Storage: FTP; SFTP; Micro SD card (support max. 256 GB); NAS
General.Browser: With plug-in: IE: IE9 and later Chrome: Chrome 86 and later Firefox: Firefox 86 and later Without plug-in: Edge Chrome: Chrome 86 and later Firefox: Firefox 86 and later
General.Certifications: CE-LVD: EN62368-1; CE-EMC: Electromagnetic Compatibility Directive 2014/30/EU; FCC: 47 CFR FCC Part 15, Subpart B
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 11.5 W (12 VDC) Max. (ICR Switch+IR intensity): 36.1 W (12 VDC)
